Free T4 is flagged as normal anywhere in a 12-22 pmol/L window, yet many patients feel their best only in the upper third of that range. And fasting insulin — one of the most important metabolic markers for unexplained fatigue — is not routinely tested on NHS panels at all, with optimal sitting below 8 mIU/L. The gap between no disease and optimal function is where private medicine operates.
